text: APPROVE: I traced the comment, prefix, raw-literal and verbatim and escaped-literal logic and found them equivalent to the original, including the `c == '/' && next is '/' or '*'` precedence. I estimate Lex at roughly 8–9 and the largest helper (`FindLiteralEnd`) at about 13, both under 15, and I see no unused variables or other warnings. I could not build it, and I could not rule out a name clash between the new helpers and existing members of this partial class.
